sloka: इतो गच्छत पश्यध्वं वध्यमानं महात्मना ।रामानुजेन वीरेण लवणं राक्षसोत्तमम् ।। ७.६९.२९ ॥
transliteration: ito gacchata paśyadhvaṁ vadhyamānaṁ mahātmanā ।rāmānujena vīreṇa lavaṇaṁ rākṣasottamam ।। 7.69.29 ॥

translations.english: Go from here and witness Lavana, the chief of Rakshasas, being killed by the great-souled hero, Rama's younger brother.
